We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. But we have no structure given. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we need number of carbonyls. Could also be deduced from IR: strong C=O around 1700 cm-1. But need count.

We have no SMILES. Maybe the sample is "at hand" meaning there is a default compound? The tools operate on "sample at hand". Likely there is a hidden compound. We need to measure IR to see carbonyl peaks. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~200 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.

We should first get carbon NMR to see number of carbonyl signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
